digest.component_or_area: CLI help system and command registry
propositions: Twenty-one visible pure-intercept routes lack help discovery in overview help and fail under `rebar help <command>` despite supporting `rebar <command> --help`
Help-backed discovery predicate must be exactly `not route.hidden and not route.retired` across four registration sites without adding route metadata
Parser descriptions must be added to reconcile.build, enrich.build, identity.build, and certs.build_trusted_env to populate overview help

Identity and config child parsers must enable help actions so `rebar identity create --help`, `rebar identity use --help`, `rebar identity key --help`, and `rebar config validate --help` return child usage instead of top-level help
Committed help artifacts must be generated for all newly discovered routes and consumed by CLI reference generation instead of independent rendering

Help system must preserve exact overview exemptions (help, bridge-fsck, bridge-probe), nested intercepts (audit, config, identity, llm, prompt, criteria, workflow), and explicit multiline trusted-env usage
